essence: The mantra structure assigns vāgbhava as peg and hrīṃ-klīṃ-hrīṃ as heart-mantra.
The eye-mantra is the stated sequence invoking Nityaklinnā and Madā.
Ten śakti-enclosed mantra syllables are to be placed.
After placement, one should visualize the goddess who bestows all happiness.
The goddess is visualized as four-armed, three-eyed, and radiant with a ruby crown.
